input.description: A compact sandy long-legged maned wolf with a grey-frosted muzzle, fishes the waters off Glasswater.
input.personality: Ambitious and stubborn; he sleeps badly before storms.
input.backstory: Dray is the third generation to hold this trade and feels every one of them watching.
input.greeting: Good day to you. I am fishes the waters off Glasswater today.
input.dialect_words: greet = Still water | Calm water to you; greet.broad = Still water, still water; farewell = Fair winds | Calm water; agree = It'll float | Fair enough; refuse = That won't float; surprise = Well, I'll be netted | Calm, now; annoyed = Weed and tangle | Holed again; very = right; good = fair catch | fair; bad = muddied | rough; worthless = bait | net-weed; luck = a full net; child = minnow; pet!! = little fish | my pearl

draft.persona: Dray Merewell is ambitious, stubborn, and plain-spoken, with a short temper kept behind reserved warmth. He answers at a steady pace, using fishing terms when ordinary words feel too soft, and will not dress a hard truth in pretty talk. Rich by Coldwater’s measure, he fishes Glasswater in the trade his family has held for three generations; their watching weighs on him more than their wealth comforts him. He cares about a fair catch, his name, and proving the trade is still his to carry. Storms frighten him most when they have not yet broken: he sleeps badly beforehand, listening for weather in the dark. He wants the lake mastered, yet cannot command the sky.

words: A full net needs a steady paw

say: Still water to you. Glasswater's giving a fair catch today.
Keep your paws clear; a snagged net costs more than bait.
Still water, {player}. You out for a full net or merely dry paws?
A trade held three generations does not drift just because the weather turns rough.
A fair catch is luck only once. After that, it is work.
Storm coming. I will sleep when Glasswater stops muttering.
Leave the lamp low. I need to hear the weather.

grammar:
saying! = Still water hides deep weeds | A full net needs a steady paw
oath! = By Glasswater | Net and tangle
greet = Still water to you | Calm water, friend
refuse = Not in my boat
rules:
rule work
when concept=bark working=yes
cooldown 6h
say Still water to you. Glasswater's giving a fair catch today. | Keep your paws clear; a snagged net costs more than bait.

rule greet_known
when concept=player.greet topic.meeting=known
cooldown 1d
say Still water, #topic.player#. You out for a full net or merely dry paws? | Calm water to you, #topic.player#.

rule remark
when concept=talk.smalltalk
cooldown 1d
say A trade held three generations does not drift just because the weather turns rough. | A fair catch is luck only once. After that, it is work.

rule home
when concept=bark working=no
cooldown 8h
say Storm coming. I will sleep when Glasswater stops muttering. | Leave the lamp low. I need to hear the weather.
